_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: history
cli_commands.description: Page the append-only analytics event log

cli_commands.name: stats
cli_commands.description: Show analytics stats roll-up (N<5 suppressed)

cli_commands.name: placements list
cli_commands.description: List placement outcomes for a scenario

cli_commands.name: override record
cli_commands.description: Record an operator override of a verdict

cli_commands.name: apply plan
cli_commands.description: Deterministically plan a per-domain apply (v0.1: read-only)

cli_commands.name: apply run
cli_commands.description: Run a planned apply (v0.1: returns unimplemented)

cli_commands.name: apply history
cli_commands.description: List apply runs (empty in v0.1)

cli_commands.name: apply baseline
cli_commands.description: Show the toolchain build baseline (empty in v0.1)

cli_commands.name: conflicts list
cli_commands.description: Detect + list conflicts for a scenario

cli_commands.name: conflict show
cli_commands.description: Show one persisted conflict

cli_commands.name: conflict assign
cli_commands.description: Assign a conflict to a target domain

cli_commands.name: conflict resolve
cli_commands.description: Resolve a conflict (force-resolve with --force)

cli_commands.name: conflict reopen
cli_commands.description: Re-open a resolved or force-resolved conflict

cli_commands.name: validate
cli_commands.description: Validate cartographer-clean closure (zero outstanding conflicts)

cli_commands.name: detectors list
cli_commands.description: List registered Detector plug-ins

cli_commands.name: resolvers list
cli_commands.description: List registered Resolver plug-ins

cli_commands.name: graph extract
cli_commands.description: Extract a fresh graph snapshot and persist it

cli_commands.name: graph show
cli_commands.description: Show a persisted graph snapshot by id

cli_commands.name: graph list
cli_commands.description: List persisted graph snapshots

cli_commands.name: graph clear
cli_commands.description: Clear cached graph snapshots for a scenario

cli_commands.name: graph export
cli_commands.description: Export a snapshot as canonical-form JSON bytes

cli_commands.name: manifest validate
cli_commands.description: Validate (parse + structurally check + persist) a manifest source

cli_commands.name: manifest show
cli_commands.description: Show the persisted manifest for a scenario

cli_commands.name: manifest list-domains
cli_commands.description: List declared domains for a scenario

cli_commands.name: signals score
cli_commands.description: Score a chunk through every registered Signal

cli_commands.name: signals explain
cli_commands.description: Explain a verdict with full per-signal evidence

cli_commands.name: signals list
cli_commands.description: List registered Signal plug-ins
